privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.updated: Draft — to be reviewed by the hospital before launch.
privacy.intro: Vihan Multi Speciality Hospital collects only the details needed to give you care and manage your appointments.

sections.p: When you book: the patient's name, age, gender, mobile number and (optionally) the reason for the visit. At the hospital: details needed for registration and treatment. Aadhaar is optional and stored encrypted; it is never shown in full.
To confirm and manage appointments, to contact you about changes (for example if a doctor becomes unavailable), and to keep your medical record. We do not sell or share your details for marketing.
Reception and IT staff see appointment and registration details. Only doctors can see clinical records. Every access to patient records is logged.
Appointment and medical records are kept as required for medical care and by law.
You can ask the hospital to correct your details. For questions, contact any of our hospitals.
